7 . A nurse is providing education to a client with a total cholesterol of 240 mg/dL. Which of the following diet 
strategies needs to be included? 
a. Continue to consume 5–7 alcoholic beverages each week 
b. Decrease intake of red meat and full-fat dairy products 
c. Decrease intake of oatmeal, lentils, and other sources of fiber 
d. Continue the current diet plan— this cholesterol level is within the accepted range 
8 . Which of the following would be an example of a DASH diet meal? 
a. Sliced ham, canned corn, and a cup of milk 
b. Fried eggs, bacon, and coffee 
c. Grilled shrimp with whole grain rice and mixed vegetables 
d. Oatmeal, sausage, and apple juice 
9 . A client is taking warfarin for a valve replacement. Which food should the nurse include in the teaching that 
the client should consistently consume? 
a. Asparagus 
b. Potatoes 
c. Water 
d. Protein 
10 . The nurse is educating a client on how to eat heart healthy. The client tells the nurse that their typical meal 
consists of traditional Mexican foods. Which meal chosen would indicate the client understands the 
instruction? 
a. Beef enchilada with cheese sauce and refried beans 
b. Nachos covered with grilled chicken, cheese, sour cream, and lettuce 
c. Quesadilla with fried shrimp, black beans, and pico de gallo 
d. Grilled chicken, onions, green peppers, and avocado with corn tortillas
